{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine|Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Caribbean cuisines|Caribbean cuisines]] | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Trinidad and Tobago|Cuisine of Trinidad and Tobago]]

'''Macaroni pie''' is a side dish that goes well with stewed [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], callaloo or any stewed peas like pigeon peas or lentils. It can also be enjoyed on its own.

It has versions derived from Caribbean, Early American and Scottish origins.

==Ingredients==
*1 package (225 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] / 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) dried [[Cookbook:Macaroni|macaroni]] pasta
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]s
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
*1½ [[Cookbook:cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Condensed milk|evaporated milk]]
*1 small [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrot]], grated
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|white pepper]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] prepared yellow [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]
*1 pat of unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
*[[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|Breadcrumbs]]

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] macaroni in salted water until tender; drain.
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] eggs until fluffy.
#Combine macaroni, eggs, cheese, milk, onion, carrot, salt, white pepper, mustard, and butter.
#Pour into a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] and sprinkle shredded cheese and bread crumbs evenly on top.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 175°C (350°F) until firm (about 30 minutes). A fork or metal [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]] should come out dry when you press it all the way through the pie.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Macaroni pie can be enhanced further by adding ingredients such as [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]], chopped [[Cookbook:Spices and Herbs|herbs]], minced [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], or roasted [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]. Also try using a few varieties of cheese together.
*Usually best when the surface has browned to an even colour.
